title: The Wall That Would Not Stand
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：material　|　正文 399 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 material 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Material, the engineer said later, is where most of the money goes and none of the thought. The retaining wall behind our house failed in 2007, eleven years after it was built, and not because of the design. The ① material was wrong: a hard, dense stone brought ninety miles because it looked well in the plans, in mortar that would not let water out. Water, an engineer told me afterwards, is the only ② material on a building site that nobody orders and everybody gets.

I was fifteen and watched it come down over four days, in the way walls do. What fell first was the coping, then a ③ material I had never noticed — the gravel behind the wall, which had been doing most of the work and which nobody had ever mentioned to us. The engineer drew it on an envelope: wall, gravel, water, and the order in which they forgive you.

Rebuilding took a summer. My father insisted on local stone, which is softer and ④ materially more expensive, and my ⑤ material objection was that it looked worse. He said the wall had to move a little every winter and come back, and that a ⑥ material which cannot move will crack instead. He was right, and I have repeated it to four architects, all of whom disliked it.

Material, in this trade, is the only thing you cannot argue with. There was another difficulty, which is the one I now teach. Behind every wall there is the ⑦ material world — clay, chalk, made ground, or something the maps do not mention — and it must be described before it is dug. The ⑧ material difference between a good and a bad investigation is about eleven thousand pounds, roughly a tenth of what a second failure would have cost.

Every material on that wall was chosen by a man who knew he would not live to see it fail. The new wall has moved twice and come back twice. My father died in 2016 and I have had the gravel checked every year since, the only maintenance it needs and the only kind anybody forgets. What I learned was not about stone. It was that the ⑨ material of a job is mostly what you cannot see. If I had to give a student one piece of ⑩ material, it would be the envelope he drew for me, and not the wall.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 材料；原料；建材
B. n. （建筑背后的）土体；物质（土壤、砾石等）
C. adj. 物质的；实体的
D. adv. 相当大地；显著地（materially）
E. adj. 实际的；实质性的（material objection）
F. n. 素材；资料（写作、研究用）
G. adj. 重要的；重大的（material difference）
H. n. 实质；要害（the material of a job）

items.q: the only material on a building site that nobody orders
then a material I had never noticed
which is softer and materially more expensive
my material objection was that it looked worse
a material which cannot move will crack instead
Behind every wall there is the material world
The material difference between a good site investigation and a bad one
the material of a job is mostly what you cannot see
If I had to give a student one piece of material

answers.why: 指墙所用的“材料、建材”，说问题出在石材选错。
指工地上的“物质、东西”，此处指水——没人订购却总会遇到。
指墙后那种“物质”，即一直在起主要作用的砾石层。
materially 作副词，意为“相当大地、显著地”，说本地石材明显更贵。
material objection 意为“实质性的反对意见”，说我当时真正的反对理由是它不好看。
同样指“材料”，说不能位移的材料只会开裂。
the material world 中 material 作形容词，意为“物质的、实体的”，指黏土、白垩、回填土这些实体土层。
material difference 意为“重大差别”，说好的与差的场地勘察差别很大。
the material of a job 指一件事的“实质、要害”，说它多半是看不见的部分。
material 指“资料、素材”，说要给学生一份资料，我会选他画给我的那只信封。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 问题出在材料上：一种致密坚硬的石材。（material）
水是工地上唯一没人订购却总会遇到的东西。（material）
本地石材更软，也明显更贵。（materially）
不能位移的材料只会开裂。（material）
好的与差的场地勘察之间差别重大。（material difference）
要害问题从来不是“我们建什么”，而是“那里已经有什么”。（material question）
answers: The problem was the material: a hard, dense stone.
Water is the only material on a building site that nobody orders and everybody gets.
Local stone is softer and materially more expensive.
A material which cannot move will crack instead.
The material difference between a good site investigation and a bad one is about eleven thousand pounds.
The material question is what is already there, not what we are going to build.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 material 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: The material was wrong: a hard, dense stone set in a mortar that would not let water out.
Water is the only material on a building site that nobody orders and everybody gets.
What fell first was the coping, then a material I had never noticed: the gravel doing most of the work.
Local stone is softer and materially more expensive, and my material objection was that it looked worse.
Behind every wall there is material that must be described before it is dug.
The material of a job is mostly what you cannot see, and the material question is what is already there.
